method: Metadata-only offline parse; observed timestamps. Native runtime, hooks and outer executor intervals unioned, never summed in parallel. Residual includes model/network/client/queue effects, not pure inference. No reasoning text inspected. Response interval boundaries are previous response completion, not request send.

status.answer_count_limitation: Native turn completion does not imply an observed final answer; final text presence does not establish correctness

totals.accounting_validation: Every response ID, per-question response count, and each native usage field agrees with controller marks; all tool outputs matched; all measured intervals have valid timestamps.
